text:
Nina (CSM): Heads-up — Perseus wants to go live next week in EU and needs a couple infra changes before launch. They asked for regional routing to eu-west, a temporary QPS bump, and a header-based exemption for our bot-checker. They said failure to meet this may push their renewal conversation.
Maya (CS): Details from Perseus: launch window 2024-06-12 09:00-12:00 UTC, expected peak 12k req/min (~200 rps), mostly short completions. They requested a 4x QPS increase for that 3-hr window and a short-term exception for header `X-Partner-Mode: perseus-live`.
Sam (Eng-Infra): 4x sounds heavy — what's current per-customer QPS? Also which model endpoints are they hitting?
Nina (CSM): Current token/QPS for them is 50 QPS across hosted. They'll primarily hit /v1/chat and embedding endpoints for fallback. They can constrain to specific routes if needed.
Tess (NetOps): For regional routing we need the target region (eu-west1) and IP prefixes or ASN for peering. Do they require edge egress or private peering?
Maya (CS): They're asking for eu-west1 over public peering + header exemption. They provided a set of CIDRs: `54.12.34.0/24`, `34.210.0.0/18`. Also they prefer not to spin up Dedicated — they want hosted with regional failover.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Immediate checklist: 1) capacity check for eu-west pools 2) temp rate window feature flag 3) header-exempt rule to bypass bot throttles. I can do (1) and (2) if NetOps confirms routing. ETA 4 hours after approval.
Tess (NetOps): Routing: we can add an egress ACL for those CIDRs and route to eu-west edge. Need a ticket with required start/end times + contact for wartime rollbacks. I'll open net-ticket.
ops-bot: Created ticket NET-4121 for egress ACL and EDGE-8792 for regional routing.
Lucas (BizOps): If we lift their QPS for a window, we should attach surge billing or temporary invoice adjustment. Do we have their PO/commit?
Nina (CSM): They're in renewal talks and likely to expand to a committed tier after this launch. Perseus legal will sign a short addendum if the window is approved. We should capture any overage so it doesn't surprise finance.
Maya (CS): Ops checklist for approval: - Confirm eu-west capacity (Sam) - Net ticket done with timeline (Tess) - Create a short-term rate policy (Sam) - Add header-based bypass rule (Sam/Tess) - Notify Billing & Sales (Lucas) - Run a test curl from their IPs 30m before window.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Proposed rate policy: scale from 50 -> 200 QPS for 09:00-12:00 UTC, auto-revert at 12:05, alert at 80% capacity. I can draft the config: ```json
{"route":"/v1/chat","match_header":"X-Partner-Mode: perseus-live","qps_override":200,"start":"2024-06-12T09:00:00Z","end":"2024-06-12T12:05:00Z"}
```
Tess (NetOps): Added rollback contact: perseus-ops@perseus.co and our oncall @tess. I'll link NET-4121 -> EDGE-8792.
Lucas (BizOps): I'll prepare an addendum template with surge rates and sign-off language. Nina, can you get a PO or email approval from the Perseus procurement lead?
Nina (CSM): Yep — pinged them and asked for PO by EOD. They replied: "confirming header approach and approving regional peering — PO coming this afternoon." :white_check_mark:
Maya (CS): Quick test snippet for Perseus to validate header path: ```bash
curl -H 'X-Partner-Mode: perseus-live' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```
Sam (Eng-Infra): If everything aligns, I'll push the rate policy to the staging cluster and schedule the config deploy 2 hours before launch. Need final green from NetOps.
Tess (NetOps): Green — NET-4121 updated with times and CIDRs. Will monitor peering health during window.
Maya (CS): Noted renewal risk in the workspace: if we can't support this launch, they may delay contracting. Recommend Sales escalate to get faster PO.
Lucas (BizOps): Got it. I'll standby for PO and we'll attach surge terms.
Nina (CSM): Thanks team — please update the NET & EDGE tickets with any changes. I'll close the loop with Perseus and request the test 30m prior.
Maya (CS): 👍
ops-bot: Ticket EDGE-8792 status -> in-progress. Assigned to Sam.
